paper_metadata.title: High Temperature Mechanical Properties of Al-Si-Mg-(Cu) Alloys for Automotive Cylinder Heads

evidence.quote: This study examined the effect of alloying elements on the high mechanical behavior of Al -Si-Mg-(Cu) casting alloys for cylinder heads.
Alloy A is similar to A356 (AC4CH) and alloy B is similar to A365 (AC4A). The T6 heat treatment was performed on both alloys

alloy C is similar to A319 (AC2B) except a lower Fe content. The T7 heat treatment was used for alloy C
Three types of Al -Si-Mg-(Cu) alloys for the cylinder head were cast using the permanent-mold gravity method.
